## 7/4/2023

```{r, echo=TRUE,fig.keep='all'}
# Straight trends on (S^1)^2
set.seed(5)
n <- 200
samp_1 <- r_path_s1r(n = n, r = 2, k = c(1, 1), angles = TRUE)

plot(samp_1,
  xlim = c(-pi, pi), ylim = c(-pi, pi), col = rainbow(n),
  axes = FALSE, xlab = "", ylab = "", pch = 16
)
clusters <- samp_1

time <- Sys.time()
res_int <- plot_MDS_py(clusters, landmark_size = .1,tol=1e-3,landmark_tol=1e-3)
print(Sys.time()-time)

time <- Sys.time()
res <- plot_MDS(clusters, tol = 1e-3)
print(Sys.time()-time)



```

```{r, echo=TRUE,fig.keep='all'}
res_mod = rep(0, n)
for(i in 1:n){
  diff = res_int[i,1]- res[i,1]
  if (diff < pi){
    res_mod[i] = res[i,1]
  }
  else {
    res_mod[i] = pi - res[i,1]
  }
}
plot(res_int[,1], res_mod,xlab="Interpolated MDS-PNS scores",ylab="MDS-PNS scores",  main = paste("Interpolated MDS-PNS scores over MDS-PNS scores, First Component"), col = c(rainbow(n)), xlim = c(-pi, pi), ylim = c(-pi, pi),pch=19) 
ml = lm(res_int[,1] ~ res_mod) 
summary(ml)

```

```{r, echo=TRUE,fig.keep='all'}
# Straight trends on (S^1)^2
set.seed(7)
n <- 200

samp_1 <- r_path_s1r(n = n, r = 2, k = c(1, 1), angles = TRUE)

plot(samp_1,
  xlim = c(-pi, pi), ylim = c(-pi, pi), col = rainbow(n),
  axes = FALSE, xlab = "", ylab = "", pch = 16
)
clusters <- samp_1

time <- Sys.time()
res_int6 <- plot_MDS_py(clusters, landmark_size = .1,tol=1e-3,landmark_tol=1e-3)
print(Sys.time()-time)


time <- Sys.time()
res6 <- plot_MDS(clusters,tol=1e-3)
print(Sys.time()-time)
```

```{r, echo=TRUE,fig.keep='all'}
plot(res_int6[,1], res6[,1],xlab="Interpolated MDS-PNS scores",ylab="MDS-PNS scores",  main = paste("Interpolated MDS-PNS scores over MDS-PNS scores, First Component"), col = c(rainbow(n)), xlim = c(-pi, pi), ylim = c(-pi, pi),pch=19) 
data <- data.frame(res_int6[,1],res6[,1])
ml = lm(res_int6[,1] ~ res6[,1]) 
summary(ml)

hist((res_int6[,1]- res6[,1])^2)
```


```{r, echo=TRUE,fig.keep='all'}
#' # Small-circle trends on (S^2)^2
set.seed(20)
n <- 200
samp_3 <- r_path_s2r(n = n, r = 2, sigma = 0.05)
layout(matrix(c(1, 2), 1))

scatterplot3d::scatterplot3d(
  samp_3[, , 1],
  xlim = c(-1, 1), ylim = c(-1, 1), zlim = c(-1, 1),
  xlab = "", ylab = "", zlab = "", color = rainbow(n), pch = 16
)
scatterplot3d::scatterplot3d(
  samp_3[, , 2],
  xlim = c(-1, 1), ylim = c(-1, 1), zlim = c(-1, 1),
  xlab = "", ylab = "", zlab = "", color = rainbow(n), pch = 16
)
centers <- get_center(clusters)

scatterplot3d::scatterplot3d(
  samp_3[centers, , 1],
  xlim = c(-1, 1), ylim = c(-1, 1), zlim = c(-1, 1),
  xlab = "", ylab = "", zlab = "", color = rainbow(length(centers)), pch = 16
)
scatterplot3d::scatterplot3d(
  samp_3[centers, , 2],
  xlim = c(-1, 1), ylim = c(-1, 1), zlim = c(-1, 1),
  xlab = "", ylab = "", zlab = "", color = rainbow(length(centers)), pch = 16
)
clusters <- cbind(samp_3[, , 1], samp_3[, , 2])
time = Sys.time()
pns_data <- plot_MDS(clusters, c(2, 2), angular = FALSE)
print(Sys.time()-time)
time = Sys.time()
pns_data_int <- plot_MDS_py(clusters, c(2, 2), angular = FALSE, landmark_tol=5e-3)
print(Sys.time()-time)



```

```{r, echo=TRUE,fig.keep='all'}
plot(pns_data[,1], pns_data_int[,1],xlab="Interpolated MDS-PNS scores",ylab="MDS-PNS scores",  main = paste("Interpolated MDS-PNS scores over MDS-PNS scores, First Component"), col = c(rainbow(n)), xlim = c(-pi, pi), ylim = c(-pi, pi),pch=19) 
data <- data.frame(pns_data[,1],pns_data_int[,1])
ml = lm(pns_data[,1] ~ pns_data_int[,1]) 
summary(ml)

hist((pns_data_int[,1]- pns_data[,1])^2)
```
